      About this item

      • PERFORMANCE: Fastest Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 Processor with TSMC's 3 nm process technology, 4 Mn+ Antutu Score and a non-Arm public architecture CPU for the first time with 20% single core improvement and 23% GPU improvement from previous generation. In addition to that, it has LPDDR5X Ultra with UFS 4.1 technology, 7000 mAh 4th Gen Silicon Anode Battery with 100W FlashCharge and 40W wireless charging. Also, iQOO 15 is IP68+IP69 rated for dust and water resistance.
      • DISPLAY: Samsung 2K M14 LEAD OLED Display for the first time ever in android. India’s brightest display with 2600nits HBM and 6000nits Local Peak Brightness. It also comes with an anti-reflective film.
      • GAMING: Supercomputing chip Q3, 2K + 144 FPS for lower power consumption and higher energy efficiency. iQOO’s 1st internally developed Game Livestreaming Assistant, PC-Grade Ray tracing technology and India's Largest Single Layer VC cooling system with 8000 mm².
      • CAMERA: Triple camera setup – 50MP Sony 3X Periscope Camera, 50MP Sony VCS True Color Camera, 50MP Ultra Wide-Angle Camera with an Upgraded 32MP Selfie Camera and 4k Video Recording. Humanistic Street Photography Camera along with AI visual effects and AI reflection erase.
      • OPERATING SYSTEM: Origin OS 6 first time ever in iQOO out of the box with 5 years of OS updates and 7 years of security patches. It comes with Origin Island, Office Kit, Lock Screen Customization.

Besides that all the three lens works too good. Front camera also work well in selfies. Videography also works smooth. You can switch between the front and all the back lenses. Besides it needs some slight improvement in some areas. Battery: 10/10 Because it delivers what it says. 7000 mAH is sufficient for a day and half if i use it normally. When playing games, it still lasts a day. There's Bypass charging also which is a great feature. Software: 8/10 because Origin OS 6 needs some refinement and smoothness in some areas like in the notification panel it doesn't go upwards when you slide back from the middle screen if there's are notification piled up. You have to use blank space to slide it up. Apart from that the media player in the quick settings panel also need optimisation. It is not optimised for some players for songs and videos. An also origin os 6 needs some more icon options to customise. Calling: 10/10. No call drops and no network drops happened till now. Voice is clear on both sides. You can go for it in this part. Data/Wifi: 10/10 wifi doesn't get frequently only when you move far away. Sim data also give 5g properly most of the time. Just when your not in a proper coverage then only you get 4g otherwise 5g 24/7. Also data switching is also smooth between both sim. RAM Management: 10/10 It's too good. I opened a game yesterday and left it as it is in a section. And today i strated that game from where i left. It's so good. Storage and sharing: 10/10 I bought top variant so it's work so fine in copying files, sharing files etc. between devices. Haven't tried the one tap transfer yet. Display. 10/10. This phone is currently hold the throne in display. It such a beautiful and bright display. Auto brightness works very well. Touch response is perfect. Scrolling and swiping between the apps is so smooth. Viewing quality top of the notch. All the features related to display like HDR10+, Dolby vision etc. works so good. You can set display according to your eyes like using extra dim, eye protection option etc. Haptics are also very good in this device. Whether it is while typing or having an incoming call or while playing games etc. Speakers: 9/10 they're good stereo speaker. Not very loud not very soft. Clarity is good. Weight: It feels so lightweight in hand when you hold it. But my suggestion to use case to avoid slippery experience 😂 Charging: 10/10 It delivers what it says. You get 2 options to charge when carger is connected: normal and fast. You can use it according to you schedule. Charing works very well. When you start charging at 20% it takes around 40-45 minutes to charge tilll 90% because i have set the upper limit to 90 only. For 100% it would take another 5 minutes. (I'm telling approx time). Final Verdict: If you are interested in top performance phone with a good camera and great display. Iqoo 15 is your device. You can go for it without thinking anything. I really liked the phone. You've worked very well on this device IQOO. Just a suggestion, please provide discount offers when any sale starts. It will help people to buy it more conveniently. Now coming to the AMAZON DELIVERY SERVICE: I prebooked The Apha variant eith 16 GB RAM, 512 GB Storage on 20th November 2025. On 27th November, the window opened to order for prebooked devices and i ordered it. On 29th November, Amazon delivered the package to me but when i opened it, I found Legend with 12 GB RAM, 256 GB Storage. I immediately called customer care and raise the issue stating that worng product was packed and delovered from your side. So they said that they will do an investigation and will revert back to me in 4 working days. I called after 2 days from the delivery/complaint raised date and there was no update. I called again on 4th day in morning and they said that there's an update stating that Amazon delivered the right product and will not give me any replacement or refund. The issue was when they delivered the product first and i checked the invoice, in that invoice they mentioned Alpha 16 GB, 512 GB storage details, but the IMEI number mentioned in the inovice along with these details si of the product that was delivered actually to me, i.e., Legend 12 GB, 256 GB. I cross checked that IMEI on Iqoo's website to confirm and it shows the same Legend variant details which is mentioned above here. I tried explaining the whole issue but they didn't listened and comletely raise their hands and not gave any further support. Then one of my known person and also one of my friend suggested me to go to IQOO service center and show them the whole issue with order details and product delivered. Iqoo team listened and taken all the details with the mail proofs that i sent to Amazon team stating my issue before contacting with iqqo service center and then they connected with Amazon's team and showed the Issue to them. Two days after i reported iqoo the issue, I received a mail from Amazon executive team to resolve my issue and this was the second last day of the return window closing and they raised a pickup stating that they initiating a complete refund of the phone and asked me to order with the current price after receiving the refund at that time which was 76k with discount and they will credit the difference between the actual amount on which i order originally and the current price to my amazon pay balance as a gift card. This was not acceptable to me but i complied with it there's no issue in this and I appreciate this part by amazon. Also, another thing which i didn't liked in your delivery that you added open box delivery but charge RS. 149 also from me. This is also not a good thing. But, if anyone is reading this from Amazon's team please i request you please listen to customer's issue if these type of things happens. If someone order an expensive product you guys need to listen to the customer and stop replying only on your investigation and all. You guys really need to improve you delivery process and also the support team. And don't portray a customer that he's lying. I appreciate you, and thank you that you listened and resolved the issue. But i had to face this type of experience and to look out for the ways to make you guys listen which was not good for me. Make some improvement in this type of area. Also, there was an offer with the pre booking which was a free Iqoo TWS 1e and an extended warranty for an year. I received the tws but after doing this whole refund process and then making me ordering again. The Amazon team told me that they can't honor the. Extended warranty offer for me. Which is not acceptable. I Demand @Amazon team to give me that offer also which was originally with the pre-booking when i pre booked the phone originally. I appreciate Iqoo in helping me to make my issue gets resolved quickly. Thank you Iqoo team. Guys, I'm giving advice from my personal experience, please make sure everything is ok when receiving the product if it is this much costly. I received the product which i wanted on 19th december, 2025 after this whole Chaos.

          TRULY A LEGEND IN PERFORMANCE & FLAGSHIP KILLER😈
          Reviewed in India on 3 February 2026
          Colour: AlphaSize: 12GB+256GB
          Verified Purchase
          Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
          Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

          I’ve been using the iQOO 15 for about two weeks now, and honestly, it’s a bit of a sleeper hit. If you’re tired of paying "luxury" prices just for a brand name, this is definitely worth a look.

          ​The Good Stuff:

          ​Insane Performance: The chipset in this thing is a monster. I play a lot of CALL OF DUTY mobile, DIABLO mobile ,PUBG, ASPHALT LEGEND and it handles max settings without breaking a sweat or turning into a hand warmer. The 144Hz refresh rate makes everything feel buttery smooth.

          ​Charging is a Life-Saver: It comes with an incredibly fast charger in the box (thank you, iQOO!). I can get a full day's worth of juice in about 15–20 minutes. It’s a game-changer for those "oops, I forgot to plug it in" mornings.

          ​Display: The screen is vibrant and gets plenty bright even under direct sunlight. Watching HDR content on YouTube looks fantastic.

          ​Premium Feel: It feels solid in the hand. The design is sleek, and the haptics (vibrations) feel tight and premium, not buzzy.

          ​A Few Trade-offs:

          ​The Software: FunTouch OS has definitely improved, but there’s still a bit of "bloatware" (pre-installed apps) you’ll want to delete or disable right away. Once you clean it up, it’s fine.

          ​Camera: The cameras are actually quite good for daylight shots and portraits. However, if you’re a professional mobile photographer, it might not quite beat the ultra-expensive flagships in extreme low-light zoom, but for 95% of people, it’s more than enough.

          ​Final Verdict:

          ​This phone is a performance-first device. If you care about speed, gaming, and fast charging, you won't find a better bang-for-your-buck right now. It punches way above its weight class.

          About this Item

          • PERFORMANCE: Fastest Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 Processor with TSMC's 3 nm process technology, 4 Mn+ Antutu Score and a non-Arm public architecture CPU for the first time with 20% single core improvement and 23% GPU improvement from previous generation. In addition to that, it has LPDDR5X Ultra with UFS 4.1 technology, 7000 mAh 4th Gen Silicon Anode Battery with 100W FlashCharge and 40W wireless charging. Also, iQOO 15 is IP68+IP69 rated for dust and water resistance.
          • DISPLAY: Samsung 2K M14 LEAD OLED Display for the first time ever in android. India’s brightest display with 2600nits HBM and 6000nits Local Peak Brightness. It also comes with an anti-reflective film.
          • GAMING: Supercomputing chip Q3, 2K + 144 FPS for lower power consumption and higher energy efficiency. iQOO’s 1st internally developed Game Livestreaming Assistant, PC-Grade Ray tracing technology and India's Largest Single Layer VC cooling system with 8000 mm².
          • CAMERA: Triple camera setup – 50MP Sony 3X Periscope Camera, 50MP Sony VCS True Color Camera, 50MP Ultra Wide-Angle Camera with an Upgraded 32MP Selfie Camera and 4k Video Recording. Humanistic Street Photography Camera along with AI visual effects and AI reflection erase.
          • OPERATING SYSTEM: Origin OS 6 first time ever in iQOO out of the box with 5 years of OS updates and 7 years of security patches. It comes with Origin Island, Office Kit, Lock Screen Customization.

          Product description

          The iQOO 15 is powered by the Fastest Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 processor with LPDDR5X Ultra, UFS 4.1, and a large 7000mAh battery with 100W fast charging. It runs on Origin OS 6 - First time ever in iQOO out of the box with 5 years of OS updates and 7 years of security patches. It features Samsung 2K M14 LEAD OLED display with 2600nits HBM and an anti-reflective film. For gaming, it includes the Supercomputing Chip Q3, 2K 144Hz efficiency, PC-Grade Ray tracing technology, and India's Largest Single Layer VC cooling system with 8000 mm². The triple 50MP camera setup delivers pro-grade photography along with an upgraded 32MP selfie camera and advanced AI tools.
